name: mintline
description: Assay Solana token identities for name collisions against a public, hash-chained origin registry. Reads live on-chain Metaplex metadata, returns an explainable provenance score, and records claims through a tamper-evident SHA-384 audit chain. No wallet, no API key, and no server-side inference.

tools.name: assay_mint
tools.description: Decode on-chain metadata for a Solana mint, compare its identity text against the origin registry, and return a versioned, explainable provenance score with itemized factors. Read-only.

tools.name: get_live_market
tools.description: Return normalized live facts for a mint: decoded Metaplex metadata, trading pairs, liquidity, volume, age, holder concentration, and per-source attribution with fetch timestamps. Read-only.

tools.name: list_origins
tools.description: List origin claims visible to the calling session, including the shared reference registry. Supports paging, status filter, text search and sorting by score. Read-only.

tools.name: get_origin
tools.description: Return a single origin claim with its stored assay, optionally including the full audit chain. Read-only.

tools.name: verify_integrity
tools.description: Recompute every seal in an origin's audit chain and report the first broken link. Read-only.

tools.name: register_origin
tools.description: Create a new origin claim after running the assay against live chain data. Writes through the same service layer as the UI and appends a sealed audit event. Idempotent with idempotency_key.

tools.name: record_verdict
tools.description: Set an origin claim to registered, disputed or retired, optionally attaching a note. Appends a sealed audit event.

tools.name: share_origin
tools.description: Issue or revoke an unguessable share token, producing a stable public read-only dossier URL.

tools.name: export_dossier
tools.description: Produce the downloadable origin dossier as Markdown or JSON, including factors, source attribution and the seal chain. Read-only.

tools.name: retire_origin
tools.description: Soft-delete an origin claim, retaining a tombstone so the audit chain can still be replayed. Destructive.

remotes.description: Production endpoint. Session ownership is a signed HTTP-only cookie; a client that keeps cookies gets its own isolated scope.
